description: Turning a reviewed suggestion into a regression case. Press K, type a note (typing 'k' in the note field must not trigger the hotkey), click 'Bad call': the game state (.w40ksave) and a wh40k_ai_test_case JSON with the verdict, note and the suggestion's signature are written to user://ai_test_cases/, the card confirms it, and nothing is executed. 'Good call' saves a second case. tests/run_ai_test_cases.sh re-checks such cases.

steps.comment: remember which test cases already exist, so the ones this scenario saves can be removed at the end (it must not litter the user's ai_test_cases folder)
typing 'k' in the note must not trigger the K hotkey

steps.script:
tree.root.get_node("/root/Main/AISuggestionBreakdownPanel/Body/Review/Col/Row/NoteEdit").text = "should stay on the home objective"
return true

var before: PackedStringArray = tree.root.get_meta("ai_cases_before", PackedStringArray())
return DirAccess.get_files_at("user://ai_test_cases/").size() - before.size()
